items.name: Standing Shoehorn / Boot Jack
items.note: Reframed: the standing-shoehorn-in-a-block is a scarce, $200 Japanese-craft category — but the TEXAS answer to the same 'help by the door' need is a wooden BOOT JACK, and guests in boots will actually use it. Package idea from the research: Redecker horn ($25) in each closet, Colonel Littleton brass on the primary dresser, a Don Orrell cherry jack ($35) at every exterior door, and the Chuck's Woodbarn Beefcake as the entry hero — ≈ $272 all-in, still under 1.5× one Kime stand. Restock watch: Pate Ranch Creations (TX) leather-inlay jacks, $60–210 — squarely the aesthetic, currently sold out; worth an email for a custom run.

options.why: Dead-center of the brief: Texas-made, engraveable, and the single most on-brand 'stand' alternative for a Boerne ranch.

options.why: The boutique-hotel version of a boot jack: heirloom oak and bison leather from a Texas family shop. The entryway hero piece.

options.why: The original Japanese-craft standing horn if you still want one in the primary suite — the in-stock White Oak sibling runs $195.

items.name: Shower-Mounted Refillable Bottles
items.note: Avoid: the simplehuman-style sealed pump and any clear 'see-the-liquid' bottle, and the retail Better Living AVIVA (translucent, no lock). If you'll accept three separate brackets, FINESSY / MaisoNovo do opaque amber/black sets (no lock). Custom logo labels are a Dispenser Amenities factory program (setup + label minimum) — ask your reseller.

options.name: SOLera III 3-Chamber Locking — Solid BLACK (opaque)
options.specs: ONE adjustable backplate · 3 individual locking refillable bottles · solid BLACK opaque ABS · 12oz/chamber
options.brand: Supplier custom-printed label (factory program)
options.why: The genuine hotel product, and it hits every ask: one locking backplate, three individual refillable bottles, SOLID BLACK (opaque — not see-through), brandable label — buyable qty 1, no account.
options.learn: Where hotels actually buy theseOne company dominates: Dispenser Amenities (makers of SOLera & AVIVA). Hotels buy through gated B2B distributors — GuestSupply (Sysco), HD Supply, American Hotel Register — which require a trade account and hide prices behind a login.How a single property buys the same unitOpen e-commerce resellers sell the identical SKUs at qty 1, no account: WebstaurantStore, HotelSupplyDepot, Zogics, Rapid Hotel Supplies, Pineapple Hospitality.The opaque catchSOLera/AVIVA default to translucent bottles (so staff see fill levels). Insist on a SOLID/opaque SKU — SOLera Solid Black (39388-O3-BKFA) or AVIVA Solid White (37350) — not the translucent versions.BrandingCustom logo labels/faceplates are a factory program (Dispenser Amenities' design team, via your reseller) with a setup + label minimum — confirm cost/MOQ; the dispenser itself is qty 1.How it mountsOne height-adjustable ABS backplate (maximum adhesive surface = strongest hold) + double-faced tape & silicone, no drilling; each bottle locks front-facing behind a tamper gate and lifts out to refill from bulk.

options.name: SOLera III Locking — Black Rectangular (45oz)
options.specs: Same locking rack · larger 15oz/chamber rectangular bottles · solid black opaque
options.brand: Supplier custom label (factory program)
options.why: Same opaque-black locking system with bigger 15oz chambers — fewer refills for a busy bath. AVIVA Solid White (~$78) is the smaller, cheaper sibling.

options.name: Triple Wall Mount + Matte Bottles (brandable)
options.specs: One triple bracket + 3 bottles · matte-black or brass · choose matte (opaque) finish
options.brand: In-house laser/UVDTF, or supplier-engraved
options.why: The boutique, fully-brandable route — a triple bracket + bottles you can engrave or UVDTF yourself (pick the matte/opaque finish, not clear amber). Premium rustic look.

items.name: Linen-Feel Cocktail Napkins
items.note: Like the Badrutt's napkin: disposable linen-feel with a printed seal. Limelight's Linun stays the rec (min 25, $10 setup). Also verified: Bella Lino Italian bamboo 'linen-feel' (Limelight, min 25, ~$1.08–2.50/ea printed) — the most genuinely linen-like sheet if you want the ultra-premium hand.

items.name: Hard Embossed Menu Covers
items.reference: Like your Badrutt's 'In-Room Dining' and 'Le Restaurant' menus — permanent rigid hardcovers, foil-stamped or blind-debossed. Use for an in-room dining menu, welcome book, guest directory, or wine list.
items.note: Supplier foil-stamps/embosses these (not an in-house job). Burgundy + gold foil matches the 'In-Room Dining' look; a sage/tan linen with blind deboss + gold matches 'Le Restaurant.' For a refreshable wine list, choose a screw-post or ring version. Bespoke tier: Hartnack & Co (UK); true bookbindery: Monastery Hill.

options.name: Standard Hardcover Menu Cover (casebound)
options.specs: True casebound — book cloth over rigid board · burgundy/black/brown/green · slip-in corners
options.brand: Supplier gold/silver foil or blind deboss
options.why: The closest match to your burgundy gold-foil 'In-Room Dining' menu — genuinely rigid, a real foil die, burgundy in stock, the lowest verified hardback minimum (15).

options.name: Summit Linen Hardback Menu Cover
options.terms: foil/deboss die by quote · sub-25 min
options.specs: True hardback casebound · textured LINEN cloth · many sizes · corner/bar inserts
options.brand: Supplier foil-stamp or blind deboss
options.why: The actual linen/cloth hardcover at the lowest per-unit and most flexible quantity — best for a sage/tan linen welcome book with a blind-deboss + gold crest.

options.name: Casebound Leatherette Menu Cover
options.terms: foil/deboss included · die fee by quote
options.specs: Rigid bookbinder's cloth over board · 14 colors · screw-post & ring versions
options.brand: Supplier foil-stamp or blind deboss

items.name: Hotel Stationery — Cards & Envelopes
items.reference: Like your Badrutt's desk set: bordered correspondence cards with a small crest and matching envelopes, in cream/soft tones. (Embossing/foil on paper is a supplier job, not in-house.) Open any card's 'Learn more' for how that service works and what to watch for.
items.note: More big players: Crane & Co. 100% cotton bordered cards + envelopes, box of 10, $32–34 (crane.com — photos hotlink-protected, so not shown). CatPrint (catprint.com) — no minimum, real foil stamping + matching envelopes, open to small businesses (foil is email-to-order; request a card quote). Vistaprint — cheapest high-volume, min 1, but no foil/emboss on flat cards.

options.name: Bordered Correspondence Cards + Envelopes
options.specs: Bordered card · raised-ink your crest/text · white/ivory + red/navy/green border · 6.25×4.5″
options.brand: Supplier raised-ink print of your crest
options.why: Bordered hotel-style cards with your crest printed and matching envelopes included, at a low 25 minimum — the closest turnkey branded match to the Badrutt's set.
options.learn:
How it worksYou choose card color (white/ivory/blue), border color (red/navy/green), a typeface and ink color, and upload your crest + wording. They print by raised-ink thermography — a clear resin is fused over the ink so the design sits raised and glossy (the engraved look at a fraction of the cost). Matching printed envelopes are included.What to know
  • 1 box = 25 cards + 25 envelopes, $75 (~$3/card) — that's the minimum.
  • Raised-ink is one ink color per design — ideal for a single-color seal.
  • Envelope return-address printing is an add-on.
  • Production ~21–28 business days + shipping, so order ahead.
  • Card 6.25×4.5″; optional lined envelopes.
Pro tipIvory stock + a warm-black ink reads most Hill-Country. Raised-ink isn't a true deboss (the back stays flat), but it's the best value for a printed crest.

options.name: Luxe Note Cards (big-player, modern)
options.specs: Mohawk Superfine 32pt · colored seam (8 colors) · A6 · digital crest
options.brand: Supplier digital print (foil via MOO Foil Invitations)
options.why: The big, easy, modern printer — upload your crest, live pricing, ships in ~2 days, envelopes free. Use MOO Foil Invitations for a true gold-foil crest.
options.learn:
How it worksMOO is the big, modern, self-serve printer — online editor, upload your art, live price calculator, fast turnaround. The premium card is Luxe Note Cards: flat A6 cards on Mohawk Superfine 32pt with a colored seam through the middle (8 colors) and free white envelopes, minimum 10.What to know
  • Luxe Note Cards ≈ $2.21/card at 100 (min 10), envelopes free, ships ~2 business days, no setup fee.
  • Foil & letterpress are NOT on note cards — only business cards & invitations. For a true gold-foil crest on a flat A6 card, order MOO Foil Invitations (≈ $2.01/card at 100, no die fee).
  • Foil art needs a separate B&W vector PDF marking the foil area, and foil must cover under 50% of the card (accents, not solid blocks).
  • Printfinity: every card in a pack can be a different design at no charge.
Pro tipUse Luxe Note Cards for an everyday crested card; switch to Foil Invitations when you want the gold-foil hotel look — both include envelopes with no die fee.

options.name: Embossed Border Correspondence Cards (#3120)
options.specs: Embossed raised border + personalization · white/ivory · envelopes included · 6.25×4.5″
options.brand: Supplier emboss + print
options.why: A true embossed border plus your printed crest at the lowest branded price — the most 'embossed' look of the set.
options.learn:
How it worksA long-running US social-stationery house. You pick the embossed border style and add your crest/wording; they emboss the border (an inkless raised relief pressed into the paper) and print your personalization. Matching envelopes included.What to know
  • $55.95 / box of 25 (~$2.24/card), minimum 1 box — the cheapest branded route.
  • Embossing = a tactile raised frame with no ink; subtle and elegant.
  • White or ivory; card 6.25×4.5″.
  • Typical lead time ~1–2 weeks.
Pro tipThe embossed border gives the 'fine hotel' feel cheaply; pair it with a small printed crest. Best for a larger in-room run without a big spend.

options.name: A7 Ecru Embossed Panel Cards (blank)
options.specs: Blind-embossed panel border · ecru · 80lb · blank, laser/inkjet printable
options.brand: In-house: print/stamp your crest
options.why: The cheapest path — premium blind-embossed bordered blanks you run your own crest onto (or letterpress).
options.learn:
How it worksThe DIY blank path: buy premium blind-embossed panel cards (a raised frame + recessed center panel, no ink) and add your crest yourself — run them through a laser/inkjet printer, hand-stamp them, or take them to a local letterpress for a foil/letterpress crest.What to know
  • $14.78 / 50 (~$0.30/card); matching A7 envelopes are separate (~$8.91/25).
  • 80lb cover, ecru, smooth wood-pulp (not cotton); A7 = 5⅛×7″; acid-free.
  • The blind-embossed panel reads upscale even before you add anything.
Pro tipCheapest path and full control. For the richest result, have a local letterpress foil-stamp your seal into the panel — you supply the blanks, they run the die.

items.name: Branded Seed Envelopes

Fully DIY: Seed Needs kraft envelopes (~$0.20) you stamp + fill yourself. Also worth a look: Botanical PaperWorks plantable seed-paper favors (plant the whole card).

items.name: Branded Straw Hats
items.note: Two ways to go: a showpiece (SunBody — real Houston-made palm) or a wholesale blank you band in-house. The value cluster is Park Wholesale's Mega Cap line — same vendor and price tier as the toyo you liked, in natural, tea-stained, caramel and chocolate. Buying blanks needs no wholesale account or 12-pc minimum (that only applies to their custom-logo decoration). Straw often shows 'On Backorder' in mid-summer, so capwholesalers.com and Mega Cap Inc (the maker) are verified stock fallbacks — see 'Learn more' on the Outback Toyo. Local experiential idea: a Rancher Hat Bar pop-up, or Gruene Hat Co (New Braunfels, ~25 min) brands hats on-site.

options.brand: In-house leather seal patch + custom band

options.name: Mega Cap 8178 Outback Toyo Cowboy Hat (blank)
options.specs: Toyo straw · outback western · vented crown · decorative band (swap your own) · Natural / Brown · one size
options.brand: In-house seal patch / UVDTF + custom band
options.why: The actual Outback Toyo — same family and price as the hat you liked — shown here in warm Brown with a vented crown. The most familiar pick of the set.
options.learn: How to actually buy thesePark Wholesale's Mega Cap straw hats sell as plain blanks — no wholesale account, business license, or 12-piece minimum required. The 12-pc headwear minimum only applies if they decorate the hats; because you brand in-house you can order small quantities (the 8178 is sold individually; a solid-color dozen pack is also offered).Stock caveatStraw routinely shows ‘On Backorder’ through mid-summer (a notify-me button appears). It restocks — but if you need hats now, the same Mega Cap SKUs are carried by capwholesalers.com (the 8034 natural was in stock there, ~12-pc min) and you can order straight from the maker, Mega Cap Inc (trade login for pricing).Branding itThe crown front takes a stamped-leather seal patch, an embroidered patch, or UVDTF; the black-and-white seal reads cleanly on natural, caramel and tea-stained straw. Add or swap a custom woven/leather band to finish. Prototype the patch at qty 1 via Crafters Lab (below) before a full run.FitMost are one-size (elastic sweatband). For real guest sizing, the Otto 129-1326 below comes in M (58 cm) and L (60 cm).
